current_activity: The 12th Infantry Division detrains at Jülich and sends battalions to Verlautenheide and Stolberg
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 4 p. 88: "Straight from the railroad station at Juelich General Schack sent the first battalion of the 27th Fusilier Regiment to Verlautenheide" and "The second battalion of the 27th Fusiliers moved to Stolberg"; "When the other two regiments and some of the organic artillery detrained before daylight on 17 September". Event definition: the counterattack of 17 September against CCA and CCB of the 3rd Armored Division. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Stolberg with a precision of 5 km; the fusilier battalion also moved to Verlautenheide, north of Eilendorf. Location support: CMH names both towns. Commander: Colonel Engel. Opponents: US 3rd Armored Division (CCA, CCB).
